findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: instagram_search_posts, twitter_search, instagram_reels_search, twitter_search_posts, instagram_search_hashtag, list_endpoints · Public sink: instagram_profile, instagram_post, instagram_comments, facebook_post, facebook_comments, twitter_profile, twitter_tweet, twitter_replies, instagram_basic_profile, bluesky_profile, bluesky_post, telegram_post, youtube_community_post, instagram_post_count · Destructive: youtube_download.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: instagram_search_posts, twitter_search, instagram_reels_search, twitter_search_posts, instagram_search_hashtag, list_endpoints · Public sink: instagram_profile, instagram_post, instagram_comments, facebook_post, facebook_comments, twitter_profile, twitter_tweet, twitter_replies, instagram_basic_profile, bluesky_profile, bluesky_post, telegram_post, youtube_community_post, instagram_post_count · Destructive: youtube_download

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
